versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00327, SRS_Rte_00069 Symbolic name: RTE_E_TIMEOUT Value: 129 Comments: A blocking API call returned due to expiry of a local timeout rather than the intended result. OUT buffers are not modified. The interpretation of this being an error depends on the application.
